label: rejected

evidence.V1: Front and 3q renders read clearly as a bookcase, but the silhouette is a plain solid box from the side/back with only the top cap lip, so identity depends on the front.
evidence.V2: Big carcass and top cap, medium shelves and book groups, small varied-height books and gaps.
evidence.V3: Straight rectangular carcass and upright box books (no lean, no stacked books) - competent but stiff.
evidence.V4: Consistent chamfers on books, shelves, cap and plinth catch the light (books and top close-ups).
evidence.V5: Z-fighting hatch pattern on the side post where it meets the plinth (plinth close-up) and a dark smear on the top cap front corner.
evidence.V6: Book spine hue red in two values plus cream books and wood in two values; teal/violet colourways stay disciplined.
evidence.V8: Furniture brief met: book-spine main hue, frame wood secondary, one white vertex-colour material, chamfered edges.
evidence.V9: Furniture prop: Anchored, Box collision, CanTouch off, Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre.

artifacts: Z-fighting on the side post / plinth overlap (plinth close-up)
Dark shading smear on the front corner of the top cap (top close-up)
top_fixes: Remove the coplanar overlap between the side post and plinth to kill the z-fighting
Add a leaning book, a flat stack and small gold spine bands for silhouette and small-detail interest
Give the carcass a stronger silhouette (crown moulding / feet) so it reads beyond the front view
